name: Extra Evolution: L’Era del Primordiale
storyline:
The region of Liniles stands on the brink of a crisis as ancient as the world itself. After millennia of silence, the Primordial Pokémon have begun to awaken—legendary entities slumbering deep within the earth, guardians of Primordial Energy, a chaotic and uncontrollable force that predates even the birth of Arceus.

As the ground fractures and natural balances begin to collapse, modern society is put to the test: ancient powers, advanced technology, and new forms of danger collide.

Meanwhile, an entirely separate phenomenon is emerging: the mysterious Prism Type, a new Pokémon typing that is beginning to spread across the region. Prism-type Pokémon possess unique traits: attacks based on refraction, light, optical distortion, and color manipulation. While unrelated to Primordial Energy, these Pokémon are becoming increasingly common.

You play as a young Trainer who begins their journey just as two major threats rise:

On one side, Team Abyss, a fanatical group seeking to awaken the Primordial Pokémon in order to erase technological progress and return the world to its “original state.”

On the other, a growing instability in Pokémon ecosystems—more aggressive creatures and warped territories, twisted by the effects of Primordial Energy.

Throughout your adventure, you will:

Stop Team Abyss and uncover the truth behind the Primordial Energy;

Explore areas reshaped by unique geological phenomena;

Discover and capture Prism-type Pokémon, study their abilities, and become a Trainer unlike any other.
summary:
Extra Evolution: L’Era del Primordiale is a Pokémon fangame made by DayanVS
The game, made in RPG Maker XP + Pokémon Essentials, is set in the brand new region of Liniles and features 160 new species of Pokémon
